description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
